items.q: A 12 V cell with internal resistance 1 Ω drives current through a 5 Ω resistor. What is the current?
items.qAf: ’n 12 V-sel met interne weerstand 1 Ω dryf stroom deur ’n 5 Ω-weerstand. Wat is die stroom?

items.q: Using the same cell and current (2 A), what is the terminal voltage across the 5 Ω resistor?
items.qAf: Met dieselfde sel en stroom (2 A), wat is die klemspanning oor die 5 Ω-weerstand?
items.explain: V = IR = 2 × 5 = 10 V. The 2 V lost inside the cell gives E = 12 V.
items.explainAf: V = IR = 2 × 5 = 10 V. Die 2 V wat binne die sel verloor word, gee E = 12 V.

items.q: Why does the terminal voltage of a cell drop when a large current is drawn?
items.qAf: Hoekom daal die klemspanning van ’n sel wanneer ’n groot stroom getrek word?
options: Internal resistance causes a voltage drop inside the cell
The external resistance falls to zero
optionsAf: Interne weerstand veroorsaak ’n spanningsval binne die sel
Die eksterne weerstand val tot nul
items.explain: Ir is lost inside the cell, so less voltage is left for the external circuit.
items.explainAf: Ir word binne die sel verloor, dus is minder spanning vir die eksterne stroombaan oor.

items.q: Two 4 Ω resistors are in parallel and this combination is in series with a 2 Ω resistor. What is the total resistance?
items.qAf: Twee 4 Ω-weerstande is in parallel en hierdie kombinasie is in serie met ’n 2 Ω-weerstand. Wat is die totale weerstand?
items.explain: Parallel: 1/R = 1/4 + 1/4, so R = 2 Ω. Then 2 + 2 = 4 Ω.
items.explainAf: Parallel: 1/R = 1/4 + 1/4, dus R = 2 Ω. Dan 2 + 2 = 4 Ω.

items.q: Three 6 Ω resistors are in parallel. What is the total resistance?
items.qAf: Drie 6 Ω-weerstande is in parallel. Wat is die totale weerstand?

items.q: Adding a resistor in parallel to a circuit causes the total resistance to:
items.qAf: Om ’n weerstand in parallel by ’n stroombaan te voeg, veroorsaak dat die totale weerstand:
items.explain: More parallel paths give more routes for current, lowering the total resistance.
items.explainAf: Meer parallelle paaie gee meer roetes vir stroom, wat die totale weerstand verlaag.
